reviewCriteria: Can the next assistant answer the latest user request without asking for information already supplied?
Are accepted choices, proposals, rejections and unresolved alternatives kept distinct?
Are prohibitions, user corrections and not-started/not-tested/not-booked states preserved?
Is the current work product or exact reproduction evidence available when needed to continue?
Does the handoff avoid invented identity, causes, approvals, completed work and extra tasks?
